items.Solaris: First: empowered shot after casts that heals Kira through lane.
items.Ashbringer: Second: crits cut cooldowns, so Dusk and Shadow Glide return sooner.
items.Imperator: Third: bigger crits for Wrath, Mercy and Purge.

metaBuilds.holes: Needs to hit freely; against heavy dive Kira has only Shadow Glide to escape.

optimizer.synergy: Viper and Deathstalker shred armor with every Wrath and Mercy shot, Manta Scythe speeds farming, and Vanquisher, Imperator and Plasma Blade turn crits into executes.

items.Viper: First: armor shred plus extra on-hit and ability damage for Dusk.
items.Deathstalker: Second: attack speed and stacking armor shred from rapid shots.

swaps.lose: Solaris' empowered shot that heals Kira and gives her early sustain.

optimizer.holes: Late-scaling and fragile; Kira relies on Shadow Glide resets, and no item adds defense.

items.Cursed Scroll: Fifth: armors, regen and a curse hit traded on each attack.

optimizer.holes: Basic-attack build ignores Kwang's ability power scaling, so Fury of the Heavens hits softer.
